Name: After-effects of parieto-occipital gamma transcranial alternating current stimulation on behavioral performance and neural activity in visuo-spatial attention task
Description: This dataset contains EEG and behavior data of 18 healthy adults. During the experiment, participants were presented with visual stimuli while their brain activity was recorded using a 32-channel EEG system. The behavioral data includes reaction times and accuracy for a series of cognitive tasks designed to assess visual attention.
Acknowledgements: We thank all participants who took part in this study.
